documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.text:
I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat.

One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and immediately told the nurse on duty. She made the Safeguarding report. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated at the end of the day. We, the whole team, moved dinner earlier.

I have moving and handling training and use a hoist. We always work in pairs. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there. At the end of the shift, I write daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. I did night shifts for two years, and in the last year I moved to day shifts.

documents.title: Cover letter
documents.text:
Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I did night shifts for two years, and in the last year I moved to day shifts. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there.

I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. At the end of the shift, I write daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. I have moving and handling training and use a hoist. We always work in pairs.

In the dementia unit, residents became agitated at the end of the day. We, the whole team, moved dinner to earlier. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat. One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and immediately told the nurse on duty. She made the Safeguarding report.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
